output.decision: One checkout-session token is minted on the first request and reused for ordinary retries while valid; after explicit expiry, the next request mints exactly one replacement, then retries reuse that replacement. Rotating a token on every request is unsupported because it breaks idempotency.
output.rationale: CONTRACT.md is marked “accepted and authoritative.” The reference implementation returns the current token unless expiry is explicitly true, otherwise minting one; contract tests assert reuse on retry and exactly one replacement after expiry.
